_comment: Ready-to-paste MCP client configurations. Pick the block that matches your setup and merge it into your client's config file (Claude Code: .mcp.json or ~/.claude.json; Claude Desktop: claude_desktop_config.json).

local_stdio_venv._comment: Use the project venv directly so no activation step is needed.

remote_streamable_http._comment: Server profile. The server authenticates as KB_MCP_API_KEY and derives tenant + ACL from it; clients cannot choose their own tenant.
